transcript:
assistant: ନମସ୍କାର, ମୁଁ Nabz ର AI assistant କହୁଛି। ଏହା କି ଜଗନ୍ନାଥ ହୀରୋ? owner କିମ୍ବା sales manager ଙ୍କ ସହ କଥା ହୋଇପାରିବି କି?
user: ୟେସ୍।
user: ହଁ ହଁ। କରିପାରିବେ।
assistant:  ପ୍ରତି ସପ୍ତାହ ଭୁବନେଶ୍ୱର ର Hero dealer ମାନଙ୍କୁ ଛଅଟି ଛୋଟ ପ୍ରଶ୍ନ ପଚାରୁ, ମାତ୍ର ଦେଢ଼ ମିନିଟ୍। ଉତ୍ତର confidential ରହେ, ଆଉ call record ହେଉଛି। ଆରମ୍ଭ କରିବା କି?
user: ଆରମ୍ଭ କର।
assistant:  ଗଲା ସପ୍ତାହଠାରୁ ଏ ସପ୍ତାହ enquiry ଅଧିକ ଆସିଲା, ସେତିକି, ନା କମ୍?
user: ସେତିକି ଅଛି। ଆସିଲା।
assistant:  ଧନ୍ୟବାଦ। ଆଉ booking, ଗଲା ସପ୍ତାହଠାରୁ ଅଧିକ, ସେତିକି, ନା କମ୍?
user: ଅଧିକ ଆସିଲା।
assistant:   ଭଲ। ଏ ସପ୍ତାହ ପ୍ରାୟ କେତେ booking ହେଲା?
user: ଦୁଇ ହଜାର।
assistant:   ଧନ୍ୟବାଦ। ଏବେର ବିକ୍ରି ହିସାବରେ, ଏବେର stock କେତେ ଦିନ ଚାଲିବ?
user: ତ। କାଉ।
user: ହଁ 10।
user: ଦଶ ଦିନ ଛାଡ଼ିବି।
assistant:   ଧନ୍ୟବାଦ। Hero ଉପରେ discount ଆଉ offer, ଗଲା ସପ୍ତାହଠାରୁ ବଢ଼ୁଛି, ସେତିକି ଅଛି, ନା କମୁଛି?
user: କମୁଛି ଟିକେ।
assistant:    ଧନ୍ୟବାଦ। ଶେଷ ପ୍ରଶ୍ନ: ଗଲା ମାସଠାରୁ, customer ଙ୍କ loan reject ଅଧିକ ହେଉଛି, ସେତିକି, ନା କମ୍?
user: ତିନି। ସେତିକି।
assistant: ବହୁତ ଧନ୍ୟବାଦ, ଆପଣଙ୍କ ଦିନ ଭଲ କଟୁ।

outcome.reasoning_objective: All six survey questions were asked and answered clearly, including enquiries, bookings trend, booking number, stock duration, discounts trend, and loan rejections.

stock_days.reasoning_subjective: Dealer first said 'ତ', then clarified with '10' and 'ଦଶ ଦିନ ଛାଡ଼ିବି', meaning 10 days of stock available.

bookings_week.reasoning_subjective: Dealer explicitly stated approximately 2000 bookings this week.

callback_time.reasoning_subjective: There was no request for callback or mention of owner/manager availability in the transcript.

bookings_trend.reasoning_objective: Dealer clearly said bookings were 'ଅଧିକ ଆସିଲା', meaning 'more came'.

discount_trend.reasoning_objective: Dealer said 'କମୁଛି ଟିକେ', which means 'discounts decreased a little', indicating a downward trend.

enquiries_trend.reasoning_objective: Dealer said enquiries this week are 'ସେତିକି ଅଛି', which translates as 'the same'.

loan_rejections.reasoning_objective: Dealer said 'ତିନି' to last month's loan rejections being 'more', indicating a higher rejection rate than last month.

stock_days_status.reasoning_objective: Dealer gave a clear numeric response (10 days) to the stock duration question.

bookings_week_status.reasoning_objective: Dealer provided a clear numeric booking figure after being asked.
